question.en: What do you have to tell me?

status.en:
Studying the mysteries of the world is my primary objective.  You have no idea how many uncovered mysteries are out there, in Sarnaut. And as we reveal them, we will not only learn about our past, but we will know how to plan for our future.
If you happen to solve some mysteries over the course of your travels, make sure to come see me. Remember that you will be generously rewarded for your efforts. I hope that we'll be seeing each other often. Travel safe!

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Ancient June Magic" mystery

text.en: The mystery of the ancient June ruins has been solved! They can be used to tap into the ancient teleportation network and travel between the strange devices. The Adventurer's Stone now allows its owner to move quickly between neighboring allods. It is a wondrous device, indeed!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Selene de Ardeur on Evermeet Isle (Level 4). Once you are done with your task, speak with Hugues de Delice in Novograd to complete it (Level 6).

description.en: Kania is being torn apart by rebellion! You must find out its cause, expose the ringleaders, and put an end to the discord.

question.en:
Slow down, I don't want to miss any details!
Alright, so a certain Miroslav Kramolsky had managed to pass himself off as a descendant of the Valir. He then took advantage of the Kanian nobility's discontent with the new age to instigate a rebellion. Thanks to the persistence and selflessness of ordinary League citizens like yourself, the rebellion was subdued, the lie exposed, and the impostor killed.

status.en: Phew, there are so many twists in this story! I'm sure you had to run around quite a bit in order to solve this mystery. And for that you deserve a reward!

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Kanian Rebellion" mystery

not_ready.en: The letter taken from Danil Remizov in Lightwood starts this stage of the World Mystery (Level 9). Once you are done with your task, speak with Pavel Isaev in Novograd to complete it (Level 10).

text.en: It appears that the Kanian rebels are desperate to achieve their goal - desperate enough to ally themselves with the League's mortal enemy! Their first attempt to take advantage of the Empire's help has failed, but who knows what the future holds...

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Vladimir Zalesky in Lightwood (Level 11). Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd to complete it (Level 11).

text.en: The Kanian rebels continue to do anything to get what they want. At this point, things are headed towards an open civil war! You must expose their leader who is known only by the initials W. K. If he's defeated, the rebel activities would be crippled.

not_ready.en: The letter received from Somber Family in Siveria starts this step of the World Mystery (Level 13). Once you are done with your task, speak with Georgi Vityazev to complete it (Level 15).
You can start this stage by speaking with Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd at level 18. It leads to Darkwater and Castle Blight. Speak with Dobrinya Nikitov in Darkwater to complete it at level 22.

description.en: For many a year now, the Gibberlings have been searching for Isa - their lost homeland. Unfortunately, the hope of finding it lessens with each day. The Gibberlings need some help or else they'll be doomed to perish, like a tree that has lost its roots.

status.en:
It looks like we can congratulate the Gibberlings for finding their homeland. However, it's not like they need it. Frozen Frontier is full of celebrations right now!
All that remains is for me to record this epic tale. With the loss of their historic homeland, the Gibberlings did not despair. By calling upon the Great Dragon and the heroes of the League, the little people started to transform the harsh winter region into a flourishing garden. How wonderful!

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Lost Homeland" mystery

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with the Gray Family in Novograd at level 10. It leads to Lightwood. Speak with the Gray Family in Novograd to complete it at level 11.

text.en: Alas, the tidings are quite sad! The Gibberling scouts that searched for Isa have died. Before their death, they said that the Gibberling homeland was gone forever. No one knows if the Gibberlings will survive the destruction of their hopes and dreams.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with the Gray Family in Novograd at level 12. Speak with Froddy the Fidget at Frozen Frontier to complete it at level 14.

text.en: Now the Gibberlings' fate is clear! They have the opportunity to melt the eternal frosts of Frozen Frontier and turn it into a blooming garden. Who knows, maybe someday this snowy archipelago will change not only in appearance, but also in name. The League maps may one day show these allods as New Isa.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Veleslav Kapishev in Darkwater at level 19. It leads to Castle Blight. Speak with the Keen Family in Darkwater to complete it at level 22.

question.en: The Elves are a mysterious people, indeed. Unraveling their riddles is a difficult task.

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Great Game" mystery

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Pierre de Desirae in Novograd (Level 12). Once you are done with your task, speak with Avery de Grandeur in Siveria to complete it (Level 15).

text.en: While carrying out the Elves' task, you managed to witness a mysterious magic ritual in which the sculptor of the House de Doucer used some strange magic connected to the Astral. Could this be what the Elves of the House de Desirae warned you about? You should find a way to contact them.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Pierre de Desirae in Novograd (Level 18). Once you are done with your task, speak with Ivan Gubarevsky in Darkwater to complete it (Level 20).

name.en: Science at the Service of the Empire

question.en:
I'm sure the news about the first teleporter test will hit the headlines of all Imperial media tomorrow. Not to take anything away from the success of your mission!
By the way, I don't like the designation "teleporter". It doesn't sound good. So, what's the name that the scientist gave it? The Adventurer's Stone, isn't it? Yes, that's much better.

status.en:
Oh, the new opportunities we face every day are simply breathtaking! If we go on like this, there will be no mysteries left in the world for us to discover quite soon. I will retire then.
There's still a long way to go. If you happen to discover anything interesting, come back to me. I'll be keeping a detailed record of all mysteries, and besides, you can expect a good reward! See you soon.

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Science at the Service of Empire" mystery

text.en: The tests have been successfully completed! The Adventurer's Stone now allows its owner to use the ancient June ruins to access the teleportation trails. They move the user from one ruin to another and provide complete protection from the Astral. It is a wondrous device, indeed!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Pavel Nakhimin at Cloud Nine Health Resort at level 4. Speak with Sarbaz Raemka in Nezebgrad to complete it at level 7.

question.en: Your eye-openers will pale in comparison to the government secrets I have access to. Now what is it you have to tell me?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 22. It leads to Laboratory-13. Speak with Yasker in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 23.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Wire the Wily in Nezebgrad at level 9. Speak with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower to complete it.

text.en: The first attempt to find the descendant of the Legendary Orc has failed - Voxar the Fierce is dead. But there's still hope!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Wrokag the Northwind in Yasker's Tower at level 12. It leads to the Igsh Military District. Speak with Wrokag in Yasker's Tower again to complete it at level 14.

description.en: The Arisen owe their existence to an ancient crazed sorcerer by the name of Tep. He is their progenitor as well as their curse. The Arisen are currently searching for his whereabouts for few believe that Tep is dead.

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Eternal Enemy" mystery

text.en: Studying the heritage of Tep, the forefather of the Arisen, is one of the main tasks of the Arisen Historians. Why is it that they're so interested in this? A thirst for knowledge? A desire to know what happened to Tep—and to get even, in case he lived? Or maybe it's just the fear of a dreadful and mighty enemy?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Sarang Ahhotep in Nezebgrad at level 11. Speak with Nomarkh Khabash in the Igsh Military District to complete it at level 13.

text.en: The incident that transpired at the ZIT Headquarters has effectively answered the main question of the Arisen. Tep is alive! Not only that, he appears to be just as devious and powerful as ever. The mad necromancer may prove to be a threat to the entire world!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Sarbaz Renseneb at ZIT Headquarters at level 15. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 16.

text.en: While investigating the circumstances of the strange events on the bottom of the Dead Sea, new traces of Tep have been discovered. It appears that he is interested not only in the activities of the ZIT, but also in the power of Tensess' Gift.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Solka the Unyielding at the Dead Sea at level 18. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it at level 19.

text.en: The fears of the Arisen are justified! Tep is just as dangerous and unpredictable as ever! He has many followers and informants to keep track of everything that's happening in the world, and he jumps at any opportunity to grow stronger. Sooner or later he will reveal himself to the world once more, and there will be no choice but to fight him!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower at level 22. It leads to Laboratory-13. Speak with Negus Kheket in Yasker's Tower to complete it.

description.en: The main ideological difference between the League and the Empire is the source of holy energy. The Imperial heretics will do anything to justify their right to use holy magic. Because of this dispute, the Holy Land have become the grounds for an ideological war. It's time to put an end to these arguments and find the true source of the Light!

question.en: Do you have something to tell me? Something that will allow us to end this Imperial heresy?

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Power of the Light" mystery

text.en: Faith is a weapon as dangerous as the sword. The League has been fighting the Imperial ideology for ages. The Empire must be made to accept the truth.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Gorislav Kovchegov in Asee-Teph (Level 23). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 27).

text.en: The power of the Light is being threatened! Wicked cultists have been trying to warp it to their own ends. They have recently been very active in Coba Plateau, a place filled with mysterious artifacts. It is here that a war is taking place, but it's not being fought over the ancient treasures. It's being fought to save every soul in Sarnaut. We need the Inquisition to scorch no only the Imperial heresy, but fight the pristine Darkness.

text.en: Faith is a weapon as dangerous as the sword. The struggle with the lies of the League Priests has lasted for ages. The Empire can no longer wait! The battle for the truth must be won.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Zosim Nikulin in Eljune (Level 31). Once you are done with your task, speak with Semer Kiya on Coba Plateau to complete it (Level 31).

text.en:
The Grand Experiment was the unsuccessful attempt of the Great Mages to conquer the astral and obtain limitless power. The Spark of the Great Mage released from Tep's Pyramid told us about the old documents that confirm this assumption.

The Cataclysm that caused splitting of Sarnaut into allods was a consequence of Mages' arrogance. They thought themselves equal to gods. They paid a price, and still are paying. Should we be telling ordinary people about it? Should we stir up the past, or is it best to think about the future and, with the knowledge we gained about the experiment, try saving what can be saved?

text.en:
The conflict between Demons, Demonologists, Demon Hunters, and the Church, orchestrated by the God of Darkness, has nearly undone the fragile peace in Sarnaut.

Nihaz made it clear that he wishes to be the ruler of this world. And he is not above using one of the greatest heroes of Sarnaut to dictate his will. It was only the intervention of Skulnar the Fierce that helped prevent the catastrophe.

What does Nihaz want with this world? Is there any chance he can be stopped?

text.en:
It turns out that Nihaz and Sarn are just two of the many gods who represent certain facets of the universe, each embodying a particular aspect of power. One way or another, they were all part of the cycle of Creation and Destruction, reforming the universe bit by bit.

But then Nihaz turned against the other gods, unleashing the Great War. Nihaz wants to have the powers of Creation and the ability to create life. And capturing Sarn is just one step of his grand plan.

Every world, every god is just a tiny piece of the Creation, but those are important pieces. The confrontation of the two gods, the imprisonment and death of Sarn, the birth and development of this world - all this was preordained.  This is how the Creation works. This is how it creates life.

Some gods have come to learn it; some, despite of their tremendous power, could never get close to the mystery of life. It seems that Nihaz is really interested in the Aoidoi as a side effect of Sarn's and Architect's death.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Cosmos on Dionic Archipelago (Level 73). Once you are done with your task, speak with Klavdia Kalugina to complete it (Level 73).
You can start this stage by speaking with Cosmos in the Observatory at level 74. Speak with Klavdia Kalugina near the Observatory to complete it.

text.en:
The conflict between Demons, Demonologists, Demon Hunters, and the Church, orchestrated by the God of Darkness, has nearly undone the fragile peace in Sarnaut.

Nihaz made it clear that he wishes to be the ruler of this world. And he is not above using one of the greatest heroes of Sarnaut to dictate his will. It was only the intervention of Skulnar the Fierce that helped prevent the catastrophe.

What does Nihaz want with this world? Is there any chance he can be stopped?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Nefer Ur near the Observatory on Ammer at level 75. It leads to Sogot. Speak with Nefer Ur near the Observatory again to complete it at level 80.

You can start this stage by speaking with Skulnar the Fierce near the Observatory on Ammer at level 80. It leads to Wellebell Preserve, Frontier, and Gipat. Speak with Skulnar the Fierce in Al Rihat Ruins to complete it.

text.en:
It turns out that Nihaz and Sarn are just two of the many gods who represent certain facets of the universe, each embodying a particular aspect of power. One way or another, they were all part of the cycle of Creation and Destruction, reforming the universe bit by bit.

But then Nihaz turned against the other gods, unleashing the Great War. Nihaz wants to have the powers of Creation and the ability to create life. And capturing Sarn is just one step of his grand plan.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Klavdia in Nihaz's Citadel at the maximum level. Speak with Mark Staritsin in Yasker's Tower to complete it.

description.en: Nihaz's plans are cunning and convoluted. What does the God of Darkness want? Exact revenge on those who turned on him? Or is it something else?

question.en: Is there evil in our world that the God of Darkness hasn't had a hand in? But what is he trying to achieve?

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: God of Darkness

text.en:
So the prophesy is coming true - Nihaz is willing to destroy this world along with all its inhabitants. But his motives are still unclear - is it vengeance? Or is Nihaz trying to prevent something else? What's hidden behind his Seals?

In any event, we have no choice but to challenge him again!

not_ready.en: Cosmos starts this stage of the World Mystery in the Observatory on the Dionic Archipelago (Level 85), and Catherina finishes it there (Level 85).

text.en:
Terrible news: after Kyros and the Wanderer went through the Well of Souls, Nihaz found a way to influence the power of the two deities. For some reason, all the Aoidos born after the event obey the God of Darkness.

Does this mean Cosmos is acting in his interests? It's hard to believe, because you can't find a more staunch opponent of Nihaz than the Dominus of Creation!

not_ready.en: Stephane de Doucer starts this stage of the World Mystery in Foul Dale (Level 88), and Zayan finishes it there (Level 88).
Dakkar de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery in Gipat (Level 89) and finishes it there (Level 89).

text.en: Klavdia intends to fight Nihaz. For that, she needs to create the Gates to another world where her "mother" rules. This world is apparently under attack by Nihaz. However, that doesn't mean Sarnaut is safe - the Dark God could have been behind the attempt to disrupt the construction of the new Gates on Suslanger. We must find out more!

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Dakkar de Desirae in Gipat (Level 90). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 90).

text.en: Mysterious Alice claims that she's Klavdia from the future! She wanted to warn us about the Gate-III first opening and its consequences. According to Alice, we must stop. Trying to find her "mother" is dangerous. Will Klavdia from our time agree? Is this all part of Nihaz's plan?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Alice on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Alice to complete it (Level 96).

You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the Great Mage Simon on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Semer Akhenaten on Eden to complete it (Level 96).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Skulnar the Fierce on Eden (Level 97). Once you are done with your task, speak with the All-Mother on Eden to complete it (Level 97).

text.en: All-Mother's lessons taught you that death according to her is only part of the natural cycle of everything that has ever existed. Her children share her views and live in harmony with the nature. However, some rejected her teachings. You ran into Hirkalla, Klavdia's sister, who attracted corrupted Children on her side.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with the All-Mother on Eden (Level 98). Once you are done with your task, speak with this NPC again to complete it (Level 98).

text.en: All-Mother's lessons allow you to see deeper into the conflict with Nihaz. The All-Mother considers all elements important, be it Light or Darkness. As the god of Darkness, Nihaz was assigned his own tasks in accordance with her will. It seems that his main fault was resisting her will and acting of his own accord. You also met Hirkalla. She seemed very interested in you after hearing about you from a mysterious Madman from Sarnaut. The goddess of Darkness started a rebellion on Eden, drawing some of the Children to her side.

description.en: The Great Ball is a marvelous event in the lives of all elves. It takes place once in several decades. The previous Ball was disrupted by Armando de Doucer, who corrupted the Galleon Castle on Tenebra. Stakes are growing higher! Victory of one of the Houses may influence the confrontation of the Empire and the League.

question.en: How's the Great Ball going on? Did they manage to avoid accidents this time?

status.en:
What? I can't believe this!

Who could've thought we'd run into the House de Velund? There are only vague legends about Elleken. And Louis's decision to contact him seems rather reckless...

Even though Zayan took on training Skulnar the Fierce, I don't think it's the end of it. Orcs got their Great Mage after all, which means.... Shamans have a strong argument in their favor now.

We've received news from Siveria - the word of Skulnar has reached them, too. Orcs started leaving their settlements. Where are they going? I don't know.

But intelligence reports that the Empire is moving its troops to Izune - the orcs' main allod. Perhaps the rebellion Yasker feared has already started. A few years ago I would've been happy to hear about trouble in the Empire, but now... when they are our allies... I don't know what to think!

The world is changing. Irreversibly. Orcs, elves, and even Gibberlings... they seem to be willing to go their own way.

solved_title.en: You have solved the "Great Ball" mystery

text.en: This time the elven King Louis invited representatives of all races of Sarnaut to the Great Ball. The Sarnaut hero received the invitation as well. Aidenus wants to use this opportunity to persuade elves to quit the Empire.

not_ready.en: Zayan starts this step of the World Mystery on Al Rihat (Level 90), and Louis de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

text.en: Both the League and the Empire are pursuing their goals during the Great Ball. The event is full of mysteries, intrigues, and secrets. The confrontation between the Great Houses is heating up. As always, those, whose job is to take orders, suffer the most. Among them is a servant of Queen Lucretia, the harpy Constance, who got caught in a trap thanks to a mysterious assistant of the Cardinal, Renard de Ardeur.

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

text.en: All this scheming on Irene leads to unexpected discoveries. It turns out that Queen Lucretia is secretly corresponding with Xadaganians, and King Louis has enlisted the help of Skulnar the Fierce. Strange actors from the wandering theater, who recently arrived at Irene, take keen interest in the orc psionicist. Apart from that, we managed to find out the cardinal's assistant is Eurial, whom we've already met. She doesn't have any idea of what lies ahead.

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Lucretia de Desirae finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

text.en: The Great Ball is on! Every Great House is looking to win the competitions and seeking all possible means to achieve it. King Louis is dreaming about peace for his subjects. He asks to find one of Antoinette's elven daughters. She was captured by the Empire, and had to leave the Royal Court. The elven lady, Iris de Delice, seemingly has some information that might shed some light on the mysteries of Irene.

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).

text.en: You managed to find out more about the events on Irene. It seems that the disappearance of Iris de Delice is connected with Eurial's affairs. Eurial is spying on Queen Lucretia de Desirae. She knows of her connection with a high-ranking officer of the Empire and wants to use the information against her and her allies.

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts and finishes this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90).
You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Louis de Desirae on Irene at level 90. It leads to Ferris. Speak with Lucretia de Desirae to complete it.

text.en: The Great Ball is in full swing! Rivers of wine are flowing, beautiful ladies are showing off their outfits, and men are making speeches. Each of the Great Houses strives to win and demonstrate their achievements. But it is not yet clear who will win.

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Baudouin de Grandeur finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

text.en: House de Delice won a convincing victory at the Great Ball! Which means the League failed to achieve its goals. We can only hope Antoinette de Delice won't end the alliance with Kania. In addition to that, the Great Houses also decided to grant an amnesty to the vampires and the House de Doucer. This Great Ball passed seemingly without incident - does this mean everything is over and the forces that intervened in the Great Game remain unrevealed?

not_ready.en: Louis de Desirae starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene and finishes it there (Level 90).

text.en: The intrigue that had been carefully built up at the Great Ball reached its resolution - Skulnar the Fierce was kidnapped by Eurial and her accomplices, unknown elves! He was taken to ancient catacombs, and his further fate is shrouded in mystery! You have no choice but to follow them, hoping to save Skulnar. But first you need to get through the collapsed passage.

not_ready.en: Skulnar the Fierce starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Constance finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

text.en:
The truth is out! You have unraveled the tangle of intrigues surrounding the Great Ball!

The first of the Great Mages, Elleken learned about the Star Gates from Nihaz. He decided to leave Sarnaut and started looking for a perfect navigator who possessed unparalleled intuition to help him travel between worlds. For that purpose, he stole the Key of Creation, a powerful artifact, one of Nihaz's Seals. Using this Key, he changed an orc, granting him magical abilities. He was working on it with the House de Vevre on the Grok allod. But then his plans failed. Lorzub the Fierce, who later became known as the Legendary Orc, died in the attempt to become a Great Mage.

But Elleken did not know he had an offspring. Only after learning of Skulnar the Fierce, the first of the Great Mages decided to make another attempt at initiating the orc as a Great Mage. He contacted Caspar de Vevre and King Louis de Desirae to arrange for Skulnar to be invited to the Ball. After that, he only needed to get him to the Draconid held captive deep in the allod.

Now Skulnar the Fierce has no choice but to complete the Great Mage training - or he will die! Who knows what the appearance of a Great Orc Mage would mean for Sarnaut?

not_ready.en: Constance starts this stage of the World Mystery on Irene (Level 90), and Skulnar the Fierce finishes it on Irene (Level 90).

What? I can't believe this!

Who could've thought we'd run into the House de Velund? There are only vague legends about Elleken. And Louis's decision to contact him seems rather reckless...

Even though Zayan took on training Skulnar the Fierce, I don't think it's the end of it. Orcs got their Great Mage after all, which means.... Shamans have a strong argument in their favor now.

Alas, we've started receiving terrible news - there's a riot on Izune. Of course, it's the Shamans who stirred it up as soon as they heard about Skulnar. Yasker already ordered the army to move in. There's trouble in other places as well. Orcs are worried, prophets keep popping up who predict that, "the new Great Feast is around the corner"...

Nezeb was right when he said more orcs meant more problems! Without wars, they wilt, start making trouble, turn to crime, and there have been no wars since Dane... Now we have our hands full.

The world is changing. Irreversibly. Orcs, elves, and even Gibberlings... they seem to be willing to go their own way.

description.en: The League and the Empire have been around for more than two hundred years. These are alliances of peoples brought together by common interests. But will they survive the coming upheaval? Will the Gibberlings and Elves remain in the League? While the Orcs and rebellious Zem stay in the Empire? Or will the upcoming conflicts lead to the creation of new alliances?

question.en: What awaits the League and Empire?

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: Conflicts

text.en: Skulnar the Fierce became the Great Mage, and it led to the revolt of the Orcs. Now the shamans of our people, and the warriors who joined them, have sworn allegiance to the new leader, the Legendary Orc. They believe Skulnar is the one.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Fury the Merciless on Suslanger (Level 94). Once you are done with your task, speak with Eladia on Suslanger to complete it (Level 94).

text.en: Perhaps the conflict of League and Empire is history? New generations are learning to live in peace, cooperate, resolve arguments with words. At least this is the case in the Dune pioneer camp where all races of Sarnaut meet. Will this friendship become an eternal alliance?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Eladia on Suslanger (Level 95). Once you are done with your task, speak with Alice on Suslanger to complete it (Level 95).

text.en: Gray Prince wants to bring Nezeb back to life. Is it possible? Skulnar managed to cheat death, but can the Great Mage of Xadagan repeat this? Will the return of the first Emperor lead to a conflict with Yasker? And what is Nezeb going to do in a new world?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Gray Prince on Suslanger (Level 96). Once you are done with your task, speak with Eladia on Suslanger to complete it (Level 96).

text.en: The journey to Eden caused a new rift. Choosing between the Expedition from Sarnaut or the Children, the natives of Eden, will have a decisive impact on the future of many worlds. Each side has its own truth, and now everyone in Eden needs to decide which side they are on. This threatens to break the precious truce achieved at a high cost. Perhaps you are witnessing the beginnings of a conflict that will last for centuries, just like the war between Kania and Xadagan back in the day.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Catherina in Eden at level 100. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

text.en: The discovery of Isa, the original homeland of the Gibberlings, raises new questions about the future of this people. Will they stay in the League they once joined in search of their old home, or will they choose neutrality? The appearance of the first Skulnar, the legendary leader of the Horde, also raises many questions.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Froddy the Fidget on Isa at level 105. Once you are done with your task, speak with Aidenus in Novograd.

text.en: You've managed to accomplish the impossible - bring Nezeb and Skrakan back to life! The fate of the entire Sarnaut will change forever. Where will this all lead? How will the Empire react to the return of its Emperor? How will the League's policies change with the return of the oldest of the Great Human Mages? Who knows...

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Hirkalla on Jigran at level 110. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: Fate

text.en: Using your Weaver powers, you managed to enter the Hall of Fates where you stopped the spirit of an ancient Orc chieftain from binding the fate of the Gibberlings to his own. You also encountered the Fate of the All-Mother and managed to change it. What you learned on Isa raises the following questions: is Fate some kind of force that surpasses even demiurges? And what can oppose Fate?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Styr Ruff on Isa at level 104. Once you are done with your task, speak with Unn on Isa.

text.en: You have seen something extraordinary - a mysterious creature calling itself "the Scissors". If Unn was not mistaken, then they are your eternal enemy, because you are the Weaver who binds the Threads. But what do the Scissors want? Did your intervention in the fate of the Gibberlings summon them?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Yasker in Yasker's Tower at level 105. Once you are done, speak with Negus Tot in Yasker's Tower.

text.en: Looks like the Scissors have made their move. According to Alice, the fates of some ancient inhabitants of Sarnaut tragically changed: instead of becoming key figures in history, they are "odd people out" - people without destinies. What kind of force can steal someone's destiny?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Alice in Dar Ulgorn at level 107. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.

text.en: A Zem scientist has learned the following: the Spark is a multi-component entity contained in the concept of "soul". The Spark contains a certain "primordial flame" which makes it the basis of life. The flame is surrounded by the Threads of Fate. Invisible and ethereal, they extend from each Spark out into space. The Scissors cut the Threads of certain people, changing their place in the Pattern.

question.en: What fate awaits all of us?

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: Fate

text.en: Using your Weaver powers, you managed to enter the Hall of Fates where you stopped the spirit of an ancient Orc chieftain from binding the fate of the Gibberlings to his own. You also encountered the Fate of the All-Mother and managed to change it. What you learned on Isa raises the following questions: is Fate some kind of force that surpasses even demiurges? And what can oppose Fate?

question.en: Can the Gibberlings find their home?

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: Lost Isa

text.en: You traveled to Howlem which had already begun to collapse. With the help of the spirits of the First, the guardians of this allod, you were able to awaken another sleeping First One - the squirrel Ratatoskr. She claims that Isa still exists! According to the squirrel, Isa was preserved by the Great Ash Tree, the first of the Great Trees of Sarnaut.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Gaal-Irhen on Howlem at level 100. The stage will be complete next to Vegvisir on Isa.

text.en: Surprisingly, the Vegvisir spell worked, transporting you to some kind of snow-covered allod! Is it really Isa? It made you wonder why the Gibberlings were unable to find it and why they were so sure Isa was lost forever. Evidently they were wrong.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Unn on Isa at level 101. Once you are done with your task, speak with this character again.

text.en: On Isa, you encountered a strange little Gibberling that did not have her own sprout. She also inherited a pendant made of meteoric iron from her forefathers. The local Gibberlings had not discovered its properties, so this raised many questions.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Gerda on Isa at level 101. Once you are done with your task, speak with this character again.

text.en: The Thread Keepers in Skalgard told you about the history of Isa and informed you that your arrival set an ancient prophecy into motion: it brought their ancient enemy Kharyskhan, the leader of the wild Uruns, back to life. You needed to fix what you had done.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with the Strand family on Isa at level 102. Once you are done with your task, speak with these characters again.

text.en: The guardian of the volcano, Surt Junior, informed you that Gerda's amulet had indeed been made by the Zvergs about 200 years ago. However, he was sure there were no meteorite deposits on Isa, so this metal had come from somewhere outside Isa. The Zvergs could tell you about this but, unfortunately, they had been dead for a long time.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Surt Junior on Isa at level 103. Once you are done with your task, speak with Randy Ladle on Isa.

text.en: After visiting the old Gibberling cemetery, you learned where Gerda's ancestors could have come from and how they got the meteorite pendant. However, to finally answer all the questions, you needed to make a trip to the most remote parts of Isa.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Gerda on Isa at level 103. Once you are done with your task, speak with this character again.

text.en: An old Werebear told you about a mysterious incident in the mountains that had taken place 200 years ago. Since Gerda was able to trace her ancestors back less than 200 years, we could assume that we were on the right track - something had happened then that connected the meteorite pendant and the little Gibberling's family.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Beorn's Spirit on Isa at level 104. Once you are done with your task, speak with Murk on Isa.

text.en: The truth was out! Gerda's ancestor, Captain Koll, once made an agreement with the descendant of Skulnar the Northwind, Brus, and this agreement helped him find Isa. However, after learning from the Thread Keepers what fulfilling this commitment would mean, Koll abandoned it. With his help, the Thread Keepers captured Skulnar's spirit and then severed Koll's Thread of Fate. Thus Isa was hidden from the rest of the world. But there was a prophecy that the descendants of Koll and his brother could rediscover Isa if they reconnected the Threads of their family. And here they were - Koll's descendant Gerda, and his brother's descendants Trondur and Wickham.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage by speaking with Gerda on Isa at level 104. Once you are done with your task, speak with Trondur the Sharp on Isa.

text.en: The Gibberlings found their homeland; Skulnar the Northwind was defeated (although he promised to return); and the Sharp Family - Gerda, Trondur and Wickham - became one sprout. You also succeeded in bringing hope to the All-Mother by sending a signal to Enod, the World of Light. This meant the Great Trees would no longer wither. New battles with Fate await you, but for now everything is fine.

description.en: Tep is the most sinister person created by the world of Sarnaut. This monstrous maniac committed genocide, sacrificing an entire nation to gain more power. But for some, Tep is the messiah and prophet, leading them to the true future and granting them immortality. So who is this man who wanted to become a god? And is Tep capable of rising from the dead again and again?

question.en: Will Tep return again?

solved_title.en: Solved Mystery: Tep

text.en: After being resurrected by Hirkalla, Tep hid in the ancient catacombs under the city of Dar Ulgorn, nursing dreams of revenge. Now he's dead again, but for how long?

not_ready.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Alice in Dar Ulgorn at level 107. Once you are done with your task, speak with her again to complete it.
You can start this stage by speaking with Alyosha in Dar Ulgorn on Jigran at level 110. Once you are done with your task, speak with Yasker in Yasker's Tower in Nezebgrad to complete it.

text.en: It turns out that Tep's Cultists have hooked a machine superintelligence to the electric grid and made it calculate what Nefer Ur was up to. It is highly probable that this information is of great interest to the sinister God of Death. Thus far, the only thing known is that Nefer Ur is aiming to create some kind of New Reality.

not_ready.en: You can start this stage at the Jeb terminal in the Mana Station district on Xadagan at level 112. Once you are done with your task, speak with Nomarkh Khey at level 112, in the same place.
